landing.eyebrow: An open shelf of moving diagrams
landing.title: Concepts you can watch, not just read about
landing.lede: Load balancers, consensus, distributed systems. Each entry is a small animated model you can pause, step through, and replay — built to make an idea click in a minute, not an afternoon.

how.title: Pick a concept
how.body: Search the shelves or filter by subject and depth. Every entry says up front what it will show you.

how.title: Watch it run
how.body: Each model animates in real time. Slow it down, speed it up, or step one tick at a time.

how.title: Replay it exactly
how.body: Every run is seeded, so resetting replays the same run. Nothing is hidden behind randomness you cannot repeat.

library.title: The Library
library.lede: Every simulation on the shelves, arranged by subject.
